title: Ez Crops
description: A lightweight farming utility to harvest mature crops and automatically replant them.
body:
Ez Crops - Simple & Fast Farming
Tired of manually breaking and replanting every single wheat stalk? Ez Crops is here to make your farming life legendary! This lightweight utility mod allows you to harvest and replant your crops with a single click, saving you time and effort while keeping your farm looking great.

- Features:
-Right-Click to Harvest: No more breaking blocks! Just right-click any mature crop to collect your loot.

-Instant Replanting: The mod automatically replants a seed in its place, so the growth cycle never stops.

-Visual Feedback: Beautiful green particles (Happy Villager effect) appear to confirm a successful harvest.

-Satisfying Sounds: High-quality sound effects for every harvest to make farming feel more rewarding.

-Ultra Lightweight: Designed to be fast and compatible with your favorite modpacks.

-How to use:
Wait for your crops (Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroots) to fully grow.

Right-click on them with an empty hand or any tool.

Collect your items and watch the seeds go back into the ground instantly!

- Requirements:
Fabric Loader

Fabric API
